newsitem.title: USA: Masco sees higher Q3,to cut MascoTech stake.
newsitem.headline: Masco sees higher Q3,to cut MascoTech stake.

text.p: Masco Corp said on Wednesday it expects higher third quarter sales and earnings and has agreed to cut its stake in MascoTech Inc.

It said third quarter sales rose 14 percent from a year ago, to about $840 million, and it expects net income of about $80 million, or $0.50 a share, an increase of 28 percent over the $0.39 a share earned in the 1995 period.
Masco said it had agreed to cut its stake in MascoTech by selling to that company 17 million MascoTech shares and warrants to purchase another 10 million shares.
Under the agreement, Masco said it will receive about $266 million -- $115 million in cash to be paid at closing, and the balance due within one year.
The agreement also provides for the extension of the corporate services and financing commitment agreements between the two companies.
The pact is subject to MascoTech obtaining necessary approvals under its bank credit agreement.
As part of the transaction, Richard Manoogian, chairman of Masco, has agreed to sell to MascoTech one million shares of MascoTech at the current market price, Masco said.
Manoogian's present seven percent common ownership in MascoTech would remain about the same after Masco-MascoTech deal is completed.
Masco said the transaction is consistent with its previously stated intention to reduce its equity ownership in its MascoTech affiliate from the present 45 percent to under 20 percent.

The transaction, taking into account the mandatory conversion in mid-1997 of MascoTech's outstanding preferred stock into common stock, will result in Masco owning about 16 percent of MascoTech's common stock.
MascoTech said in a statement the deal will result in additional leverage of its balance sheet in the near term.
However, it said it believes the substantial reduction in MascoTech common shares outstanding as a result of the deal should enhance long-term financial return to shareholders.
Masco makes home improvement and building products.
Also headquartered in Taylor, Mich., MascoTech produces metal-worked components for the automotive industry.
